quests.title: Beneath Black Roots
quests.summary: Find the thing waking beneath the Drowned Orchard and end it.
quests.offeredDialogue: The orchard has started breathing again. Follow the black water below its roots and silence what you find.
quests.activeDialogue: The old roots drink from a cellar beneath the orchard. Whatever stirs there will not climb into my inn.
quests.readyDialogue: The water has gone still. You found the buried thing, didn't you?
quests.completionDialogue: Keep this charm. The pale heart remembers the hand that freed it.

quests.title: The Drowned Orchard Lamp
quests.summary: Find and defeat The Graftmother in Drowned Orchard. Examine signs and SEARCH at the last landmark.
quests.offeredDialogue: A lamp has gone dark in Drowned Orchard. Find The Graftmother; seek a concealed way beneath Forgotten Well.
quests.activeDialogue: The trail branches east. SEARCH Forgotten Well in Drowned Orchard.
quests.readyDialogue: The Drowned Orchard lamp burns again.
quests.completionDialogue: Another stretch of road remembers the light. Rest, resupply, and continue north.

rooms.name: The Copper Lantern
rooms.description: Firelight warms a low room of dark oak and river stone. Travelers speak quietly beneath a copper lantern that never seems to dim. This is Lanternwick, the last warm town on the old pilgrimage road. Type MAP for your journal and TALK KEEPER for work.

features.name: copper lantern
features.description: Its flame bends toward the north, though no draft touches the room.

npcs.name: Keeper Vale
npcs.description: A silver-haired innkeeper watches the northern door with one hand resting on a ring of iron keys.
npcs.dialogue: Keeper Vale says, “Warm yourself while you can. The marsh has a long memory tonight.”

rooms.name: The Rusted Gate
rooms.description: Rain runs down the remains of an iron portcullis. A narrow road continues north into the marsh. Fresh tracks lead east.

features.name: fresh tracks
features.description: The tracks belong to something heavy and three-legged. They are less than an hour old.

rooms.name: Market Lane
rooms.description: Lanternwick's market rings with the hammer of smith Orla. Weapons, foci and light armor hang beneath copper awnings. SHOP lists prices; BUY and SELL trade for gold.

features.name: chalk marks
features.description: Seven names repeat in a careful hand. The eighth has been scrubbed away.

rooms.name: The Drowned Orchard
rooms.description: Rows of dead apple trees rise from black water. Pale fruit hangs from one branch, untouched by rot.

features.name: pale fruit
features.description: The skin is cold and flawless. Something shifts inside when you touch it.

creatures.name: marsh crawler
creatures.description: A mud-armored thing balanced on three hooked limbs.

rooms.name: The Root Cellar
rooms.description: Black roots knot through a flooded stone vault. At its center, a wooden figure rises and falls as though the whole orchard breathes through it.

features.name: buried heart
features.description: A pulse travels through the largest root. Each beat sends a ring across the dark water.

creatures.name: rootbound keeper
creatures.description: A tall shape of drowned wood and rusted orchard tools, moving to the rhythm beneath the roots.

rooms.name: The Green Bottle
rooms.description: Dried mint and bitter smoke fill Nessa's shop. Draughts help between fights; REST is always free. SHOP to browse.

rooms.name: Lanternwick Bell Square
rooms.description: Five unlit lamps stand around a road marker: orchard, briar, cinder, abbey, crown. The keeper collects reports from all five lands. Search the wilderness for their hidden guardians.
